highlightAliases.old: Atypical parkinsonisms (PSP, MSA, CBS) have a combined prevalence of 5% to 10% of PD's (p938).
highlightAliases.new: Atypical parkinsonisms (PSP, MSA, CBS) have a prevalence of roughly 5% to 10% of PD's (p938).

highlightAliases.old: Amantadine — 100 mg BID for PD symptoms, 300–400 mg/day for antidyskinetic effect; confusion, hallucinations, livedo reticularis; poorly tolerated in older adults (p944). Only established effective antidyskinetic agent (antiglutamatergic).
highlightAliases.new: Amantadine, immediate release. The chapter describes 100 mg twice daily for motor symptoms and higher doses for dyskinesia (p944). In older adults, reduced renal clearance may cause accumulation. Use renal-function-adjusted dosing and monitor confusion, hallucinations, edema and livedo reticularis. The chapter's 300–400 mg/day range is not a routine geriatric starting dose (US prescribing information).

highlightAliases.old: DBS (STN or GPi target) — FDA-approved 2002; for motor fluctuations/dyskinesias or medication-refractory tremor; does not improve postural instability or other axial features (p949).
highlightAliases.new: DBS (STN or GPi target) — FDA-approved 2002; for motor fluctuations/dyskinesias or medication-refractory tremor; does not improve postural instability or other axial features (p949); Current practice (not the book): NICE recommends subcutaneous foslevodopa/foscarbidopa infusion as an option for adults with advanced levodopa-responsive Parkinson disease, severe motor fluctuations and hyperkinesia or dyskinesia despite available medicines, only when apomorphine or DBS cannot be used or no longer controls symptoms and the commercial arrangement applies; FDA approved it on 16 October 2024 for motor fluctuations in adults with advanced Parkinson disease - NICE TA934 2023, 1.1 p4; FDA NDA216962 approval package cover and approval letter p1

highlightAliases.old: Peak-dose dyskinesia: reduce levodopa dose, or add amantadine (start 100 mg BID, up to 200 mg BID); buspirone up to 20 mg/day (p946).
highlightAliases.new: For peak-dose dyskinesia, consider smaller levodopa doses or amantadine when appropriate. The chapter describes 100–200 mg twice daily in selected patients (p946). For immediate-release amantadine, tailor initiation and escalation to renal function, age and neuropsychiatric tolerability. The text also describes buspirone up to 20 mg/day in selected patients.

highlightAliases.new: Focused ultrasound creates an irreversible, nonprogrammable lesion. The 2018 US indication was unilateral thalamotomy for medication-refractory tremor-dominant PD. Patients are generally awake, and local anesthetic can be used to secure the stereotactic frame (p949).

highlightAliases.old: In PDD motor symptoms precede cognitive symptoms by more than 1 year; in DLB, motor and cognitive symptoms arise within the same year (p939).
highlightAliases.new: In PDD, established motor parkinsonism begins more than one year before dementia. Dementia before, together with, or within one year after parkinsonism fits the DLB timing convention (p939, DLB Consortium 2017).
